top_signals.title: IAEA's Grossi Says Iran Nuclear Inspections Can Resume Fast
top_signals.summary: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi joins Bloomberg's David Gura at the United Nations General Assembly to discuss the nuclear situation in Iran. He says there is still a fairly important amount of nuclear material in Iran and that the IAEA can get on the ground and assess pretty fast if there is the political will for it. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: David Booth: Control What You Can Control
top_signals.summary:
Dimensional Fund Advisors Founder and Chairman David Booth explains his investment philosophy of staying calm during periods of market volatility. He explains why he didn't panic during the 2020 pandemic, when markets collapsed. He's on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations. This interview was recorded August 10 in New York.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: How David Booth Built Dimensional From A Brooklyn Brownstone
top_signals.summary: David Booth started Dimensional Fund Advisors out of a Brooklyn brownstone in 1981 with an idea that challenged conventional investing: investors should have exposure to smaller companies as part of a diversified portfolio. More than four decades later, Dimensional manages over $1 trillion. Booth is on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations to discuss how he built Dimensional and the investment philosophy behind the firm. This interview was recorded August 10 in New York.  (Source: Bloomberg)
